raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Pins the Hugging Face Base revisions in the Qwen3.5 text pretrain recipes and gives the 35B-A3B GB200 recipe the HybridEP NVLink-domain settings it was missing.

# Changelog

- `qwen35_text_9b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config` and `qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config` load the Base model's config and tokenizer at fixed revisions (`Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base@68c46c4`, `Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base@0f08130`) instead of Hub `main`, as the long-context recipe already does for its model.
- `qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config` sets `NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN=8`, `NVLINK_DOMAIN_SIZE=72` and `USE_MNNVL=1`, the values the other eight-GPU GB200 MoE recipes (Nemotron 3 Nano, Qwen3-30B-A3B) carry. Its EP8 group spans two four-GPU GB200 nodes in one NVL72 domain.
- Two unit tests in `tests/unit_tests/recipes/qwen/test_qwen35_text_recipes.py` cover the pinned revisions and the environment. Both fail on main.

# Evidence

Same-allocation A/B on 8x GB200 (two nodes in one NVL72 rack) at Bridge `0652ea797`: the 35B-A3B recipe warm-started from the imported Base checkpoint with natural routing, RedPajama2 re-encoded with the Qwen3.5 tokenizer, GBS 512, sequence length 4096. Four 20-step arms ran back to back in one Slurm allocation with a kept Triton cache, alternating the recipe on main (A) and the recipe with the three variables (B). Only the three variables differ.

| Arm | Mean step time, steps 11-20 | Model TFLOP/s/GPU |
|---|---|---|
| A, first | 24,659.9 ms | 239.0 |
| B, first | 24,426.8 ms | 241.9 |
| A, second | 24,783.0 ms | 238.1 |
| B, second | 24,450.0 ms | 241.3 |

B is faster in both pairs (0.9 % and 1.3 %): 1.1 % pooled, 24,438 ms against 24,721 ms. LM loss, MTP loss and grad norm are bit-identical in float32 across all four arms at every step (LM loss 2.134386 at step 20); only the logged load-balancing-loss metric differs, by one float32 ULP at a few steps. Peak allocated memory is unchanged (133.7 GB on rank 0).

An earlier version of this description reported 13 % (28,284 ms against 24,487 ms). Those two runs landed on different racks, and identical runs differ by up to 13 % in step time between GB200 racks, so the same-allocation result replaces it.

Tests, run locally on CPU with Transformer Engine and Triton stubbed:

- `tests/unit_tests/recipes/qwen/test_qwen35_text_recipes.py`, `tests/unit_tests/recipes/qwen/test_qwen35_dynamic_cp_recipe.py`, `tests/unit_tests/recipes/test_qwen35_text_long_context.py` and `tests/unit_tests/recipes/test_flex_dispatcher_recipes.py`: 54 passed, 1 skipped
- `tests/unit_tests/recipes/test_all_recipe_factories.py -k qwen35`: 39 passed
- `pre-commit run --all-files`: clean

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [x] Did you add or update any necessary documentation? (None needed: no user-facing option changes.)
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

# Additional Information

- The 35B-A3B recipe stays slower per token than the Qwen3-30B-A3B GB200 recipe because it runs MBS 1. MBS 2 with `moe_act` recompute runs out of memory when the CUDA graphs are captured, so a larger micro-batch is left for a separate change.
- The dynamic-CP SFT recipe in the same file also loads the 35B-A3B Base without a revision; this PR leaves it unchanged.

files.patch:
@@ -33,7 +33,9 @@
 
 
 _QWEN35_9B_BASE = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base"
+_QWEN35_9B_BASE_REVISION = "68c46c4b3498877f3ef123c856ecfde50c39f404"  # pragma: allowlist secret
 _QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base"
+_QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE_REVISION = "0f0813072d2358973511097385626f21fcb6d422"  # pragma: allowlist secret
 _QWEN35_35B_A3B_INSTRUCT_REVISION = "59d61f3ce65a6d9863b86d2e96597125219dc754"  # pragma: allowlist secret
 _CODERFORGE_REVISION = "060fca96cf723b2ebab3181e9e59fafd273df3cb"  # pragma: allowlist secret
 
@@ -194,12 +196,13 @@ def qwen35_text_9b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
     """Return a text-only Qwen3.5-9B pretraining config for eight GB200 GPUs."""
     cfg = _pretrain_common()
 
-    text_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(_QWEN35_9B_BASE).text_config
+    text_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(_QWEN35_9B_BASE, revision=_QWEN35_9B_BASE_REVISION).text_config
     # The nested text config intentionally omits ``architectures``. AutoBridge
     # needs it to select the registered causal-LM bridge instead of the VLM.
     text_config.architectures = ["Qwen3_5ForCausalLM"]
     cfg.model = AutoBridge.from_hf_config(text_config).get_model_config()
     cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_model = _QWEN35_9B_BASE
+    cfg.tokenizer.hf_tokenizer_kwargs = {"revision": _QWEN35_9B_BASE_REVISION}
     cfg.dataset.seq_length = 4096
     cfg.dataset.blend = None
     cfg.dataset.num_workers = 8
@@ -287,12 +290,13 @@ def qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
     """Return a text-only Qwen3.5-35B-A3B pretraining config for eight GB200 GPUs."""
     cfg = _pretrain_common()
 
-    text_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(_QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE).text_config
+    text_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(_QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE, revision=_QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE_REVISION).text_config
     # The nested text config intentionally omits ``architectures``. AutoBridge
     # needs it to select the registered causal-LM bridge instead of the VLM.
     text_config.architectures = ["Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM"]
     cfg.model = AutoBridge.from_hf_config(text_config).get_model_config()
     cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_model = _QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE
+    cfg.tokenizer.hf_tokenizer_kwargs = {"revision": _QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE_REVISION}
     cfg.dataset.seq_length = 4096
     cfg.dataset.blend = None
     cfg.dataset.num_workers = 8
@@ -368,6 +372,14 @@ def qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
         overlap_grad_reduce=False,
         overlap_param_gather=False,
     )
+
+    # EP8 spans two four-GPU GB200 nodes in one NVL72 domain. Use the HybridEP
+    # NVLink-domain settings of the other eight-GPU GB200 MoE recipes.
+    cfg.env_vars = {
+        "NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN": 8,
+        "NVLINK_DOMAIN_SIZE": 72,
+        "USE_MNNVL": 1,
+    }
     return cfg

@@ -108,3 +108,37 @@ def test_dynamic_cp_recipe_rejects_model_config_without_dynamic_cp(builder_only:
 
     with pytest.raises(AttributeError, match="dynamic_context_parallel"):
         _DYNAMIC_CP_RECIPE()
+
+
+def test_pretrain_recipes_pin_base_model_revisions(builder_only: None, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    """The pretrain recipes read the Base config and tokenizer at a fixed revision, not Hub main."""
+    calls = []
+
+    def load(path, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((path, kwargs))
+        return _HF_CONFIGS[path]()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qwen35.AutoConfig, "from_pretrained", load)
+
+    dense = qwen35.qwen35_text_9b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config()
+    moe = qwen35.qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config()
+
+    assert calls == [
+        ("Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base", {"revision": qwen35._QWEN35_9B_BASE_REVISION}),
+        ("Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base", {"revision": qwen35._QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE_REVISION}),
+    ]
+    assert dense.tokenizer.hf_tokenizer_kwargs == {"revision": qwen35._QWEN35_9B_BASE_REVISION}
+    assert moe.tokenizer.hf_tokenizer_kwargs == {"revision": qwen35._QWEN35_35B_A3B_BASE_REVISION}
+
+
+def test_35b_a3b_pretrain_keeps_hybridep_on_one_nvlink_domain(builder_only: None):
+    """EP8 over two four-GPU GB200 nodes runs HybridEP across one multi-node NVLink domain."""
+    cfg = qwen35.qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config()
+
+    assert cfg.model.expert_model_parallel_size == 8
+    assert cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == "hybridep"
+    assert cfg.env_vars == {
+        "NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN": 8,
+        "NVLINK_DOMAIN_SIZE": 72,
+        "USE_MNNVL": 1,
+    }
